title: Oxygen loses one π* electron
statement:
How many unpaired valence electrons are predicted in O₂⁺?

[_]{a}

explanations: A single electron is left in the π* pair.
One remaining electron cannot form a pair.
Ionization removes rather than adds electrons.

hints: Start with two singly occupied π* orbitals in O₂.
Remove one electron from a highest occupied π* orbital.
solution: Start with two singly occupied π* orbitals in O₂. Remove one electron from a highest occupied π* orbital. One singly occupied orbital remains. A single electron is left in the π* pair.
